title: Identifying three amines of formula C4H11N
body: A student was given three bottles, P, Q and R, each containing a different amine of molecular formula C4H11N. She shook a sample of each with benzenesulphonyl chloride (Hinsberg's reagent) and then added aqueous potassium hydroxide. P formed a sulphonamide that dissolved in the alkali. Q formed a solid sulphonamide that did not dissolve in the alkali. R did not react with benzenesulphonyl chloride at all. The candidate amines were butan-1-amine, N-ethylethanamine and N,N-dimethylethanamine.
